name: ionos-dns-cli

scripts.build: esbuild src/cli.ts --bundle --packages=external --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/cli.js && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --packages=external --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/index.js && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly --declaration --outDir dist && chmod +x dist/cli.js

description: Command-line client and TypeScript library for the IONOS Hosting API — DNS zones, records, and domains.
author: Michael Gajda
